details: The US October Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.4% monthly, surpassing the 0.3% forecast, with core inflation also exceeding expectations at 0.3%. This data has fueled concerns that the Federal Reserve may implement another interest rate hike in December, with some officials even suggesting a 50-basis-point increase if inflationary trends persist. Such tighter monetary policy is anticipated to make borrowing more expensive, thereby discouraging leveraged cryptocurrency investments. The crypto market reacted sharply, experiencing a significant decline in total market capitalization, with Bitcoin falling below $73,000 and major altcoins like Ethereum and Solana also seeing substantial drops. The negative sentiment led to over $700 million in leveraged long positions being liquidated across the crypto market.
title: US Inflation Exceeds Forecasts, Heightening Fed Rate Hike Fears & Crypto Decline
